% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): expression plots with trig format
% plots=rad, a domain written with pi, and samples.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xlabel={$t$}]
\addplot[domain=0:2*pi, samples=40, trig format plots=rad] {sin(x) + 0.3*cos(3*x)};
\addplot[domain=-pi:pi, samples=31, blue, thick] {cos(deg(x))*x/3};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
